growth.need-gap-cycle.bind: links receipts but performs no lifecycle stage
growth.outcome.evidence-route: Grounded Growth Outcomes admits PASS or FAIL only through the native proof surface declared for the claim kind
it validates supplied receipts and does not perform the native observation
growth.outcome.human.verify: human benefit requires a representative human journey, human observation, review, or judgment as appropriate
the adapter does not manufacture or impersonate the human evidence
growth.outcome.ai-workflow.verify: AI-workflow benefit requires a held-out or representative workflow evaluation
component tests and model participation do not satisfy the beneficiary claim
growth.outcome.refresh: changed capability evidence reopens the linked beneficiary outcome
NO_NEW_INFORMATION requires explicit ancestry and produces no new growth claim

growth.outcome.digest-receipt: outcomes bind exact cycle, baseline, result, evidence closure, and beneficiary references
portfolios refuse skipped or mismatched same-capability ancestry
growth.authority.human: Review Inbox and Verified Capability Loop preserve exact-digest human decisions
Grounded Growth Outcomes has no apply or promotion authority
growth.evidence.closure: focused source-closure repair passes current tests
candidate remains AWAITING_STEWARD and is not installed or promoted
